fact: The Burundi Development Agency, with UNCTAD and the World Bank Group, launched Easybusiness.bi, a fully online single-window platform for business registration.

The Agence de Développement du Burundi describes company and sole-trader registration, with commercial register fees of 100,000 FBU for a person and 200,000 FBU for a company, done online through the easybusiness.bi platform.
